up: Return all exact activity values for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614521. For each result, include the canonical SMILES and the ChEMBL ID. Use the exact standard_value and standard_units as recorded.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614521'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
